title: Chapter close — Stochastic mechanics
html:
This closes the stochastic-mechanics chapter. The Markov closure map, the classical-limit functor and its adelic arithmetic consequences, the \Phi_q / A_J machinery, the Lusztig canonical basis at q = 1, and the reverse limit q \to \infty assemble the Markov-trace stochastic dynamics on the substrate.

The next chapter (Information-Theoretic Perspectives) recasts this Reeb-driven Markov dynamics in informational terms: Planck-scale operations, information speed c_q, reversible braid computation, q-statistical mechanics, and computational horizons.
